headline: Congress named a Boston Postal Service facility the Caroline Chang Post Office.
what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility at 25 Dorchester Avenue, Room 1, in Boston, Massachusetts. The building is now officially called the Caroline Chang Post Office. The law does not change postal services, hours, or rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on November 25, 2024.
